Patent Panorama Insights v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a comprehensive multi-stage workflow for patent panorama, landscape, competitor intelligence, technology roadmap, and portfolio planning projects, orchestrated over PatSnap (智慧芽) MCP/API data.
- Implements five main pipeline layers: retrieval & denoising, panorama statistics & value insights, tagging system recommendation, manual client tagging, and evidence-backed HTML report generation.
- Ensures robust tool configuration with mandatory PatSnap MCP endpoints self-check before workflow execution.
- Provides default settings and structured input prompts while supporting user customization.
- Standardizes progress reporting with clear check-ins, checkpoints, and handoff steps for user and client input.
- Applies precise task eligibility and operational principles to maintain transparency and decision-driven outputs.
